=== Coloretto: Secret Favourites ===

Three players. The deck has 38 cards: 7 each of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow and Purple (5 colours), plus 3 '+2' cards. It is shuffled and the top card is turned face up. There are 3 rows, each holding at most 3 cards; all start empty.

At the start each player is dealt a different secret Favourite colour at random from the 5 colours. You see only your own; the 2 undealt colours are never shown. Every player's tableau (colour counts and +2 cards) is public throughout.

On a turn only the active player acts, choosing one legal option:
- place_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds fewer than 3 cards. The face-up card is added to row k and the next deck card is turned face up.
- take_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds at least 1 card. You add every card in row k to your tableau (each colour to its count, each '+2' to your +2 count), row k is emptied and closed for the rest of the cycle, and you have taken: you do not act again this cycle.
If every open row is full you can only take. The number of open rows always equals the number of players who have not taken, so you always have a legal option.

If all three players have now taken, the cycle ends: everyone's taken resets, all rows are emptied and reopened, the cycle number goes up by 1, and the player who just took starts the next cycle. Otherwise the turn passes to the next seat in order (s+1, then s+2, then s itself, wrapping 3 to 1) that has not taken; this can be the same player, so a lone remaining player keeps placing while their open row has room and must take once it is full. A cycle lasts at most 12 turns.

The game ends when cycle 4 would begin, after 3 cycles (at most 36 turns). Every Favourite is then announced. With T(c) = c(c+1)/2 (0, 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28 for 0 to 7 cards), F the count of your Favourite colour and o1..o4 the counts of the other four colours: score = T(F) + 2 x max(T(o1..o4)) - (T(o1)+T(o2)+T(o3)+T(o4)) + 2 x your +2 cards. So your Favourite and your single largest other colour score positive and the other three colours score negative; if other colours tie for largest, only one of them counts positive. The highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the top (a draw). There is no table talk.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

The deck is shuffled and the first card is turned face up: Purple.

Each round runs in this order: the table → legal options → the action → place the card → take the row → next player or next cycle → final scoring → favourites revealed → after the third cycle.

Actions you may be asked for:
  the_action   answer with one of the options you are given

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.

  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,

  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told

Three players. The deck has 38 cards: 7 each of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow and Purple (5 colours), plus 3 '+2' cards. It is shuffled and the top card is turned face up. There are 3 rows, each holding at most 3 cards; all start empty.

At the start each player is dealt a different secret Favourite colour at random from the 5 colours. You see only your own; the 2 undealt colours are never shown. Every player's tableau (colour counts and +2 cards) is public throughout.

On a turn only the active player acts, choosing one legal option:
- place_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds fewer than 3 cards. The face-up card is added to row k and the next deck card is turned face up.
- take_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds at least 1 card. You add every card in row k to your tableau (each colour to its count, each '+2' to your +2 count), row k is emptied and closed for the rest of the cycle, and you have taken: you do not act again this cycle.
If every open row is full you can only take. The number of open rows always equals the number of players who have not taken, so you always have a legal option.

If all three players have now taken, the cycle ends: everyone's taken resets, all rows are emptied and reopened, the cycle number goes up by 1, and the player who just took starts the next cycle. Otherwise the turn passes to the next seat in order (s+1, then s+2, then s itself, wrapping 3 to 1) that has not taken; this can be the same player, so a lone remaining player keeps placing while their open row has room and must take once it is full. A cycle lasts at most 12 turns.

The game ends when cycle 4 would begin, after 3 cycles (at most 36 turns). Every Favourite is then announced. Three players. The deck has 38 cards: 7 each of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow and Purple (5 colours), plus 3 '+2' cards. It is shuffled and the top card is turned face up. There are 3 rows, each holding at most 3 cards; all start empty.

At the start each player is dealt a different secret Favourite colour at random from the 5 colours. You see only your own; the 2 undealt colours are never shown. Every player's tableau (colour counts and +2 cards) is public throughout.

On a turn only the active player acts, choosing one legal option:
- place_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds fewer than 3 cards. The face-up card is added to row k and the next deck card is turned face up.
- take_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds at least 1 card. You add every card in row k to your tableau (each colour to its count, each '+2' to your +2 count), row k is emptied and closed for the rest of the cycle, and you have taken: you do not act again this cycle.
If every open row is full you can only take. The number of open rows always equals the number of players who have not taken, so you always have a legal option.

If all three players have now taken, the cycle ends: everyone's taken resets, all rows are emptied and reopened, the cycle number goes up by 1, and the player who just took starts the next cycle. Otherwise the turn passes to the next seat in order (s+1, then s+2, then s itself, wrapping 3 to 1) that has not taken; this can be the same player, so a lone remaining player keeps placing while their open row has room and must take once it is full. At the start each player is dealt a different secret Favourite colour at random from the 5 colours. You see only your own; the 2 undealt colours are never shown. Every player's tableau (colour counts and +2 cards) is public throughout.

On a turn only the active player acts, choosing one legal option:
- place_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds fewer than 3 cards. The face-up card is added to row k and the next deck card is turned face up.
- take_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds at least 1 card. You add every card in row k to your tableau (each colour to its count, each '+2' to your +2 count), row k is emptied and closed for the rest of the cycle, and you have taken: you do not act again this cycle.
If every open row is full you can only take. The number of open rows always equals the number of players who have not taken, so you always have a legal option.

Three players. The deck has 38 cards: 7 each of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow and Purple (5 colours), plus 3 '+2' cards. It is shuffled and the top card is turned face up. There are 3 rows, each holding at most 3 cards; all start empty.

At the start each player is dealt a different secret Favourite colour at random from the 5 colours. You see only your own; the 2 undealt colours are never shown. Every player's tableau (colour counts and +2 cards) is public throughout.

On a turn only the active player acts, choosing one legal option:
- place_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds fewer than 3 cards. The face-up card is added to row k and the next deck card is turned face up.
- take_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds at least 1 card. You add every card in row k to your tableau (each colour to its count, each '+2' to your +2 count), row k is emptied and closed for the rest of the cycle, and you have taken: you do not act again this cycle.
If every open row is full you can only take. The number of open rows always equals the number of players who have not taken, so you always have a legal option.

If all three players have now taken, the cycle ends: everyone's taken resets, all rows are emptied and reopened, the cycle number goes up by 1, and the player who just took starts the next cycle. Otherwise the turn passes to the next seat in order (s+1, then s+2, then s itself, wrapping 3 to 1) that has not taken; this can be the same player, so a lone remaining player keeps placing while their open row has room and must take once it is full. === Coloretto: Secret Favourites ===

Three players. The deck has 38 cards: 7 each of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow and Purple (5 colours), plus 3 '+2' cards. It is shuffled and the top card is turned face up. There are 3 rows, each holding at most 3 cards; all start empty.

At the start each player is dealt a different secret Favourite colour at random from the 5 colours. You see only your own; the 2 undealt colours are never shown. Every player's tableau (colour counts and +2 cards) is public throughout.

On a turn only the active player acts, choosing one legal option:
- place_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds fewer than 3 cards. The face-up card is added to row k and the next deck card is turned face up.
- take_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds at least 1 card. You add every card in row k to your tableau (each colour to its count, each '+2' to your +2 count), row k is emptied and closed for the rest of the cycle, and you have taken: you do not act again this cycle.
If every open row is full you can only take. The number of open rows always equals the number of players who have not taken, so you always have a legal option.

If all three players have now taken, the cycle ends: everyone's taken resets, all rows are emptied and reopened, the cycle number goes up by 1, and the player who just took starts the next cycle. Otherwise the turn passes to the next seat in order (s+1, then s+2, then s itself, wrapping 3 to 1) that has not taken; this can be the same player, so a lone remaining player keeps placing while their open row has room and must take once it is full. A cycle lasts at most 12 turns.

The game ends when cycle 4 would begin, after 3 cycles (at most 36 turns). Every Favourite is then announced. With T(c) = c(c+1)/2 (0, 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28 for 0 to 7 cards), F the count of your Favourite colour and o1..o4 the counts of the other four colours: score = T(F) + 2 x max(T(o1..o4)) - (T(o1)+T(o2)+T(o3)+T(o4)) + 2 x your +2 cards. So your Favourite and your single largest other colour score positive and the other three colours score negative; if other colours tie for largest, only one of them counts positive. Three players. The deck has 38 cards: 7 each of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow and Purple (5 colours), plus 3 '+2' cards. It is shuffled and the top card is turned face up. There are 3 rows, each holding at most 3 cards; all start empty.

At the start each player is dealt a different secret Favourite colour at random from the 5 colours. You see only your own; the 2 undealt colours are never shown. Every player's tableau (colour counts and +2 cards) is public throughout.

On a turn only the active player acts, choosing one legal option:
- place_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds fewer than 3 cards. The face-up card is added to row k and the next deck card is turned face up.
- take_k: allowed only if row k is not closed this cycle and holds at least 1 card. You add every card in row k to your tableau (each colour to its count, each '+2' to your +2 count), row k is emptied and closed for the rest of the cycle, and you have taken: you do not act again this cycle.
If every open row is full you can only take. The number of open rows always equals the number of players who have not taken, so you always have a legal option.

If all three players have now taken, the cycle ends: everyone's taken resets, all rows are emptied and reopened, the cycle number goes up by 1, and the player who just took starts the next cycle. Otherwise the turn passes to the next seat in order (s+1, then s+2, then s itself, wrapping 3 to 1) that has not taken; this can be the same player, so a lone remaining player keeps placing while their open row has room and must take once it is full. A cycle lasts at most 12 turns.

The game ends when cycle 4 would begin, after 3 cycles (at most 36 turns). Every Favourite is then announced. With T(c) = c(c+1)/2 (0, 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28 for 0 to 7 cards), F the count of your Favourite colour and o1..o4 the counts of the other four colours: score = T(F) + 2 x max(T(o1..o4)) - (T(o1)+T(o2)+T(o3)+T(o4)) + 2 x your +2 cards. So your Favourite and your single largest other colour score positive and the other three colours score negative; if other colours tie for largest, only one of them counts positive.
